calculation.description: Thirty-session cumulative signed return divided by thirty-session total absolute daily movement, discounted by the contemporaneous 60-session percentile rank of observation-only VIX. The complete signal is shifted one session before forecasting returns.
calculation.lookahead_control: All close and VIX inputs are lagged one completed session before use. VIX is observation-only and is never tradable.

validation.regime_notes: 20d IC was positive in 2021-2025, negative in 2020, 2026, and partial 2027; conditional 20d IC was approximately 0.0373 in low-VIX dates and 0.0537 in high-VIX dates. Interpret conservatively for the 15-asset cross-section.

notes: Admission uses daily cross-sectional Spearman IC at 20-session forward horizon; absolute IC and ICIR exceed benchmark gates of 0.0070 and 0.0840. Deterministic library-correlation audit remains pending.
